title: Puppy, Kitten and Young Adult Plans and a New Pet's Tailwise Autoship Spacing
content:
**Vet clinic coordination note**

A growing pet shortens the days between shipments of a second pet's own Autoship Everyday subscription under Tailwise Autoship (opened for an item the household already receives on another pet's Autoship). The plans are read from the customer's Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans records.

1. When the customer holds a Puppy Wellness Plan or Kitten Wellness Plan in status active, 4 days are taken away.
2. When there is no such plan but the customer holds an Adult Dog Wellness Plan or Adult Cat Wellness Plan in status active enrolled no more than 365 days ago, 2 days are taken away.
3. Otherwise no days are taken away.

The age of an adult plan is the calendar days from its enrollment date to the day the value is worked out.

| Puppy or Kitten plan active | Adult plan active and enrolled no more than 365 days ago | Days taken away |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | 4 |
| No | Yes | 2 |
| No | No | none |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** Adult Cat Wellness Plan enrolled 365 days ago: 2 days. Enrolled 366 days ago: none.
